title: Extreme battery drain with latest dev-m and DynISF using.
symptom: With the latest dev version, battery drains in hours instead of days, and the smartphone becomes very warm. The issue occurs when using DynISF, but also reported without DynISF.
cause: The battery drain was caused by xDrip sync, as identified by MilosKozak, and fixed in a commit. However, the issue reappeared in a later dev version when using DynISF, but was resolved after further updates.
fix: The fix was to update to the latest dev version that included the xDrip sync fix. Additionally, deactivating Automation in settings helped for one user, and switching from DynISF to SMB temporarily resolved the issue.
